REPORT
Date July 19, 1937.
Subject Local cultural circles to commemorate the death of Loo Sing (魯迅),
the late prominent left wing writer.
Made by Clerk Liao Chung Chien Forwarded by C Crawford. A.S.

Some 30 persons, most of whom are left wing writers, held
a tea party in the C.U.A. Restaurant, No.104 Bubbling Well
Road, between 3 p.m. and 5 p.m. July 18, 1937. Zung Tseng
Toh (鄭振鐸), a professor of the Chinan University, Chenju,
and leader of the Shanghai Cultural Circles National Salvation
Association, presided.
Discussions took place and the following measures in
connection with the commemoration of the death of Tseu Zu
Jen (周樹人), alias Loo Sing, the late prominent left wing
writer, were passed:-
1. That a "Loo Sing Memorial Committee" be organized and
Madame Sun Yat-sen be appointed President of the Committee.
2. That the Committee establish two offices, one in Shanghai
and the other in Peiping.
3. That the following seven persons be appointed to take
charge of the Shanghai Office:-
Mao Dung (茅盾) - a writer.
Hsu Kwang Ping (许廣平) - -do-
Dien Chung (田軍) - -do-
Tsang Tien Yih (張天翼) - -do-
Li Lih Vung (李烈文) - -do-
Hu Yu Tse (胡愈之) - a journalist and a committee
member of the Race Salvation
Association.
Zung Tseng Toh (鄭振鐸) - Leader of the Cultural Circles
National Salvation Association.
4. That funds be raised for the purpose of establishing a
"Loo Sing Prize" to be donated to the best scholars and
writers in the country.

（印：OFFICE OF S.I. 20 JULY 1937）
（批：Die / DBR / 20/7）

报告
日期：1937年7月19日。
主题：本地文化界纪念已故著名左翼作家鲁迅（Loo Sing）之死。
由办事员廖仲谦（Liao Chung Chien）撰写，由 C Crawford 助理专员转呈。

约30人，其中大多为左翼作家，于1937年7月18日下午3时至5时，在静安寺路104号C.U.A.餐厅举行茶话会。暨南大学（Chinan University, Chenju）教授、上海文化界救国会领导人郑振铎（Zung Tseng Toh）担任主席。
会上进行了讨论，并通过了以下关于纪念已故著名左翼作家周树人（Tseu Zu Jen），别名鲁迅（Loo Sing）的措施：-
1. 组织“鲁迅纪念委员会”，并任命孙逸仙夫人（宋庆龄）为委员会主席。
2. 委员会设立两个办事处，一个在上海，另一个在北平。
3. 任命以下七人负责上海办事处的工作：-
茅盾（Mao Dung）- 作家。
许广平（Hsu Kwang Ping）- 同上
田军（Dien Chung）- 同上
张天翼（Tsang Tien Yih）- 同上
李烈文（Li Lih Vung）- 同上
胡愈之（Hu Yu Tse）- 记者，民族救亡协会委员。
郑振铎（Zung Tseng Toh）- 文化界救国会领导人。
4. 筹集资金，设立“鲁迅奖”，捐赠给全国最优秀的学者和作家。

（印：特务科办公室 1937年7月20日）
（批：Die / DBR / 20/7）

November 4, 1936.    Morning Translation.
Date ...... / ...... / ......

Ta Kung Pao and other local newspapers :-

DEATH OF MARSHAL TUAN CHI JUI

It is learned that the Executive Yuan, at a
meeting held yesterday, passed the following resolutions
in connection with the death of Marshal Tuan Chi Jui :-
1) That the national flag be hoisted at half-mast on
November 5 when the ceremony of encoffining the remains
of the late Marshal Tuan Chi Jui will be held.
2) That the late Marshal be given the posthumous rank of
General of the highest grade.
3) That the late Marshal be accorded a State burial.
4) That a sum be contributed towards the funeral expenses
of the late Marshal.

Many high Government officials have sent
telegrams of condolence to the family of Marshal Tuan Chi Jui.
President Lin Sen of the National Government,
who arrived in Shanghai from Nanking at 6.50 a.m. yesterday,
visited the residence of the late Marshal on Avenue Joffre,
French Concession, to offer his condolence. He was
accompanied by General Yang Fu, Woosung-Shanghai Garrison
Commissioner.
Amongst other high Government officials and
prominent persons who called yesterday were Mayor Wu Te Chen,
Dr. Chu Min Nyi, General Tsai Chin Chun and Mr. Yu Ya Ching.

Central China Daily News and other local newspapers :-

PUBLIC BODIES TO INAUGURATE A "COMMITTEE IN MEMORY OF THE
LATE LEFTIST WRITER MR. LU SIN"

At 3 p.m. November 2, the family of the late
Leftist writer Mr. Lu Sin (鲁迅) and the Funeral Affairs
Committee gave an entertainment to Messrs Tsai Yuan Pei,
Sun Chun Shih (沈钧儒) and 50 other representatives of
various public bodies, and members of the Funeral Affairs
Committee.
Mr. Hu Foong (胡风) reported that as the work
of the Funeral Affairs Committee was now over, a Committee
in memory of the late Mr. Lu Sin should be inaugurated.
Mr. Tsai Yuan Pei, Madame Sun Yat Sen and
others were subsequently appointed members of the Committee
and entrusted to make arrangements for a memorial service
to the late writer in the name of the various public bodies.

《大公报》及其他本地报纸：-

段祺瑞元帅逝世

据悉，行政院在昨日举行的会议上，就段祺瑞元帅逝世一事通过了以下决议：-
1) 11月5日举行已故段祺瑞元帅入殓仪式时，下半旗致哀。
2) 追赠已故元帅为特级上将。
3) 给予已故元帅国葬待遇。
4) 拨出一笔款项资助已故元帅的丧葬费用。

许多政府高官已向段祺瑞元帅家属发送唁电。
国民政府主席林森于昨日上午6时50分从南京抵达上海，前往法租界霞飞路已故元帅寓所吊唁。陪同他的是淞沪警备司令杨虎将军。
昨日前往吊唁的其他政府高官和知名人士包括市长吴铁城、朱民谊博士、蔡晋椿将军和虞洽卿先生。

《华中日报》及其他本地报纸：-

各公共团体将发起成立“纪念已故左翼作家鲁迅先生委员会”

11月2日下午3时，已故左翼作家鲁迅先生家属及治丧委员会宴请了蔡元培先生、沈钧儒（Sun Chun Shih）先生以及其他50多位各公共团体代表和治丧委员会成员。
胡风（Hu Foong）先生报告称，鉴于治丧委员会的工作现已结束，应发起成立纪念鲁迅先生的委员会。
随后，蔡元培先生、孙逸仙夫人等人被任命为委员会成员，并受托以各公共团体的名义安排这位已故作家的追悼事宜。

October 31, 1936.
NIPPO(30-10-36)
（印：SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL POLICE S. B. REGISTRY. No. D 6772）

SITUATION IN THE NORTH BECOMES GRAVE

The Nippo publishes the following
leading article:-
The Taiyuan incident will
create difficulties in the Sino-Japanese negotiations.
So long as the Nanking Government prolongs the negotiations,
troubles will take place. This policy of protraction is due
to the fact that the National Government and the Chinese
people are in too fear of Japan. For instance, when
they hear the words "North China" or "co-operative anti-
communist campaign" they fear that Japan intends to invade
North China and later South China. Japan has been
misunderstood by China because of such propaganda which
is also the cause of the anti-Japanese movement and of the
so-called anti-Japanese united front which is being
discussed everywhere. The leftists are attempting to
make use of this fear of Japan. General Chiang Kai Shek
and other high officials may accept Japan's demands and
suppress anti-Japanese activities in the belief that
China cannot fight Japan, but they are not in a position
to control the anti-Japanese feelings of the people.
The leftists are attempting to unite their anti-Japanese
front with that of the students.
A number of leftists acting on
the instructions of the Soviet Ambassador and the Soviet
Military Attache are proceeding to the North to hold
important conferences and to instigate disturbances after
which they will return to Shanghai to start similar work.
Soviet Russia fears Sino-Japanese rapprochement for it will
lead to a joint anti-communist campaign. For this reason,
the Soviet is giving every possible assistance to the
anti-Japanese front. Japan will not tolerate these
Soviet activities in Shanghai. We must take decisive
action.

NIPPO

JAPANESE AMALGAMATED ASSOCIATION AND THE EXTRA
SETTLEMENT ROADS

At 8 p.m. yesterday the North
Branch of the Japanese Amalgamated Association of Street
Unions held a conference with representatives of thirty-one
street unions to consider the question of Extra-Settlement
roads because there are great Japanese interests in the
Northern district. Further discussions will be held at
the beginning of next month.

MAINICHI

ANTI-JAPANESE ACTIVITIES OF TSIANG NAI CHI

On October 22 when the funeral of
the well known Chinese writer Lu Shin took place, the popular
front connected the late writer with the anti-Japanese
movement. After several persons had delivered speeches
at the International Cemetery, some person suddenly called
out the names of Madame Sun Yat Sen and Mr. Tsiang Nai Chi
and both of them stood up and delivered strong anti-Japanese
speeches.
Mr. Tsiang Nai Chi is the leader of the anti-Japanese
popular front. Madame Sun Yat Sen and Tsiang Nai Chi are
leftists; they are the connecting links between the popular
front and the communist party.

NIPPO(36年10月30日)
（印：上海公共租界工部局警务处特务科登记处。编号 D 6772）

华北局势趋于严峻

《日日新闻》（Nippo）发表以下社论：-
太原事件将使中日谈判陷入困境。
只要南京政府拖延谈判，麻烦就会发生。这种拖延政策是由于国民政府和中国民众过于恐惧日本所致。例如，当他们听到“华北”或“合作反共”等字眼时，便担心日本意图入侵华北，进而入侵华南。由于此类宣传，日本被中国误解，这也是反日运动和所谓反日统一战线到处被讨论的原因。左翼分子正试图利用这种对日本的恐惧。蒋介石将军和其他高官可能认为中国无法与日本作战，从而接受日本的要求并镇压反日活动，但他们无法控制民众的反日情绪。左翼分子正试图将其反日战线与学生联合起来。
一批左翼分子奉苏联大使和苏联武官的指示，正前往北方举行重要会议并煽动骚乱，之后他们将返回上海开展类似工作。苏俄担心中日修好，因为这将导致联合反共行动。因此，苏联正在尽一切可能援助反日战线。日本不会容忍苏联在上海的这些活动。我们必须采取果断行动。

NIPPO

日本同业公会与越界筑路

昨晚8时，日本街道工会同业公会北部分会与31个街道工会的代表举行会议，讨论越界筑路问题，因为北区有大量的日本利益。下月初将进行进一步讨论。

MAINICHI

蒋乃炽的反日活动

10月22日，在中国著名作家鲁迅（Lu Shin）的葬礼上，人民阵线将这位已故作家与反日运动联系起来。数人在国际公墓发表演讲后，有人突然高喊孙逸仙夫人和蒋乃炽（Tsiang Nai Chi）先生的名字，两人随即起立发表了强烈的反日演讲。
蒋乃炽先生是反日人民阵线的领导人。孙逸仙夫人和蒋乃炽是左翼分子；他们是人民阵线与共产党之间的联络纽带。

Ta Kung Pao and other local newspapers (Peiping telegram) :-
A CERTAIN NATION TO REORGANIZE THE TROOPS UNDER BANDIT
WONG YING
A certain nation is dissatisfied with Wong
Ying, a bandit leader in Charhar. Wong Ying has enlisted
in all some 8,000 bandits and this certain nation had
intended to place Wong's men under the command of Li Shih
Sin.
Wong Ying is much disappointed and for this
reason, the attempt to invade Suiyuan has been postponed.

The Shanghai Pao :-
ARREST OF SIAO KOMPO
Huang Yao Tseng (黄耀珍), better known as
Siao Kompo (小江化) is notorious in Tai Hsien, Kompo,
as a manufacturer of red pills.
Last month one of his followers who was
arrested by the Chiangnei Public Safety Bureau disclosed
Siao Kompo's hiding place at Yuen Tsz Tuan, Kompo. The
Police made a raid and arrested Siao Kompo and five of
his followers, while a large case of red pills was seized.
It is learned that the men will be handed over to the
Chinkiang Garrison Commissioner's Headquarters to be dealt
with.
Siao Kompo was formerly a loafer in the
International Settlement and enjoyed a certain amount of
influence among the lawless elements.

The Iron News (铁报) :-
GRAND MEMORIAL SERVICE FOR LATE LEFTIST WRITER
In commemoration with the death of Chow Shih
Jen (周树人), popularly known as Lu Sin (鲁迅), a
well known Chinese leftist writer, the Chinese Cultural
Circles Co-operative Society, is planning to publish a
special magazine. Contributions are being solicited
throughout the country. The magazine will probably appear
about the end of February next year.
It is also learned that the various local
public bodies are planning to hold a grand memorial service
to commemorate his death.

National Herald (神州日报) :-
THE POOTUNG WATERWORKS COMPANY
The laying of water mains in Pootung by the
Pootung Waterworks Co., established by the Shanghai Shing
Nieh Trust Company, is nearing completion. The company
will be able to supply water to Pootung residents before the
end of the year.

《大公报》及其他本地报纸（北平电）：-
某国拟整编匪首王英部下
某国对察哈尔匪首王英感到不满。王英共招募了约8,000名匪徒，该国原打算将王的部下置于李守信指挥之下。
王英深感失望，因此，入侵绥远的企图已被推迟。

《上海报》：-
小江化被捕
黄耀珍，更广为人知的名字是小江化（Siao Kompo），在高邮泰县以制造红丸而臭名昭著。
上月，他的一名追随者被江内公安局逮捕后，供出了小江化在高邮袁子团的藏身之处。警方进行突袭，逮捕了小江化及其五名追随者，并缴获了一大箱红丸。
据悉，这些人将被移交给镇江警备司令部处理。
小江化以前是公共租界里的无业游民，在不法之徒中享有一定的影响力。

《铁报》：-
已故左翼作家盛大追悼会
为纪念中国著名左翼作家周树人（Chow Shih Jen），俗称鲁迅（Lu Sin）的逝世，中国文化界协进会计划出版一期特刊。正在向全国征集稿件。该杂志预计将于明年二月底左右出版。
另悉，各地公共团体正计划举行盛大的追悼会以纪念他的逝世。

《神州日报》：-
浦东自来水公司
由上海兴业信托公司成立的浦东自来水公司在浦东铺设水管的工程已接近尾声。该公司将在年底前向浦东居民供水。

Social Daily News (社会日报) :-

JAPANESE PEOPLE'S INTEREST IN THE LATE LEFTIST WRITER

The Japanese people and newspapers showed
more concern in the death of Tseu Dzu Jen (周樹人),
better known as Lu Sin (魯迅), a leading Leftist writer,
than the people of China. This would seem to indicate

Sir,
Re attached, I beg to report that although a Permit for 300
persons was issued in respect to the funeral of the late Tseu
Zu-zung approximately 1500-2000 persons attended.
In view of the information received from the Special Branch
that there was a possibility of radical elements taking the
the opportunity of staging demonstrations, also that the
procession was proceeding to the cemetery via Extra Settlement
Roads, I did not consider it advisable to interfere with the
formation of the procession which moved off at 2.45 p.m. instead
of 2 p.m. as authorised.
Prior to moving off all participants were issued with a
leaflet (attached) praising the life work of the deceased.
This was chanted by members of the procession at various
intervals during the course of the march.
I personally accompanied the procession from the Funeral
Director, Kiachow Road, to the junction of Tifeng & Great Western
Roads during which time there was no demonstrations of any kind.
Police from this Station who accompanied the procession to the
International Cemetery, Hungjao Road, also report that there was
no demonstrations or shouting of slogans.

the end of the procession, shouted epithets at Japanese students
attached to the Tung Wen College who were watching the procession
on Columbia Road. He states that he did not report this to
Police from this Station as they were at the head of the
procession.

敬启者，
关于附件，谨报告如下：尽管就已故周树人先生的葬礼签发了
300人的许可证，但实际出席人数约为1500至2000人。
鉴于从特别部收到的情报称，激进分子有可能利用
此机会举行示威，且送葬队伍将经由越界筑路地区
前往墓地，我认为不宜干涉送葬队伍的集结。该队伍于
下午2时45分出发，而非获准的下午2时。
在出发前，所有参与者都分发了一份传单（附后），赞扬
逝者的生平事迹。在行进过程中，队伍成员不时高呼
传单上的内容。
本人亲自陪同送葬队伍从胶州路的殡仪馆行至
提篮桥路与大西路（Great Western Roads）交汇处，在此期间

SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL POLICE.
Special Branch - S.27 Station,
REPORT
File No. 6779
Date October 23, 1936

Subject Funeral of Tsou Zu Zung on October 22, 1936.

Made by D.S. Pitts. Forwarded by [签名]

At 2.30 p.m. October 22, 1936 the funeral cortege of
the late Tsou Zu Zung (邹韬奋), left the premises of the
International Funeral Directors of China, 207 Kiaochow Road
en route for the International Cemetery, Hungjao Road, where
it arrived at 5 p.m.

Some 1800 persons, mainly composed of male and female
students attended to pay their last respects, forming a
mile long procession.

Whilst proceeding along Colombia Road, a group of some
100-150 male students at the rear of the procession, commenced
to shout in unison:

"Down with the Kuomintang," "Down with the traitors,"
"Down with Imperialism," and
"Down with the Japanese,"

giving the clenched-fist communist salute after each slogan
had been cried.

The shouting of these slogans was continued up till the
junction of Columbia and Hungjao Roads, where about 30-50
Japanese students from Tung Wen College were congregated.

Shortly after, however, a number of uniformed police officers
from Bubbling Well Station and the Bureau of Public Safety
ostentatiously arrived, coincident with which the shouting
of slogans ceased, the procession then moving along in an
orderly manner.

At the ceremony in the cemetery, patriotic songs were
sung and tribute paid to the memory of the deceased, short
speeches eulogising his deeds being given by:

Dr. Tsai Yuan-pei (蔡元培), President of the Academia

报告
档案号 6779
日期 1936年10月23日

事由 1936年10月22日周树人葬礼。

撰写人 D.S. Pitts。转呈人 [签名]

1936年10月22日下午2时30分，已故周树人（邹韬奋）
的灵柩离开胶州路207号中国国际殡仪馆，
前往虹桥路国际公墓，于下午5时抵达。

约1800人出席致哀，主要由男女学生组成，
形成了一英里长的送葬队伍。

当队伍沿哥伦比亚路行进时，队伍尾部的一群约
100-150名男学生开始齐声高呼：

“打倒国民党，”“打倒卖国贼，”
“打倒帝国主义，”以及
“打倒日本人，”

每喊完一个口号后，便做出握拳的共产主义敬礼手势。

这些口号的呼喊一直持续到哥伦比亚路与虹桥路的
交汇处，那里聚集了约30-50名来自东亚同文书院的
日本学生。

然而不久后，多名身着制服的静安寺捕房及公安局
警员显眼地抵达，与此同时，口号呼喊停止，
随后队伍有序行进。

在公墓举行的仪式上，人们唱起爱国歌曲并向
逝者致敬，以下人士发表了简短演讲，颂扬其事迹：

蔡元培博士，中央研究院院长
